# Translync

> Real-time AI translation for live events. Attendees scan a QR code and hear translation in their language instantly.

Translync is a web-based platform that provides real-time AI-powered translation for events, churches, NGOs, universities, and community gatherings. Speakers talk naturally into a microphone, and the AI transcribes, translates, and delivers audio in 70+ languages to attendees' phones — no app download required.

## Key Facts

- 70+ languages supported
- Under 2 seconds latency
- $3/hour per language pricing
- 30 free minutes per month
- No hardware or interpreters needed
- Works in any browser via QR code
- Speaker diarization (multi-speaker support)
- Domain-specific glossaries (churches, NGOs, universities, communities)
- Real-time text and AI voice output

## Use Cases

- Church services and sermons
- NGO conferences and field trainings
- University lectures and seminars
- Community town halls and immigrant services
- International conferences and events

## How It Works

1. Organizer creates a translation session at translync.app
2. Shares a QR code with attendees
3. Speaker talks — AI transcribes and translates in real-time
4. Attendees hear or read the translation on their phone
